input.question: Is this vulnerability being exploited in the wild?
input.sources:
[1] (CISA KEV) CVE-2026-31337 in Fortinet FortiGate is listed in the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Required action: apply mitigations per vendor instructions. Known ransomware campaign use: Known.
[2] (The Hacker News) Fortinet confirmed active exploitation of the pre-auth RCE flaw. Attackers are deploying webshells on unpatched FortiGate devices exposed to the internet.

input.sources: [1] (The Hacker News) Malicious versions of httpkit were published for six hours after a maintainer account compromise. Versions 3.2.1 through 3.2.3 are affected; the registry removed them. The payload exfiltrates environment variables.
